clips.title: The story
paras: Bandits hold the Dagger Hills, the rocky heights behind Moonbrook in southern Westfall. With royal patrols gone, the ridge threatens travelers and the plains below.

The Dagger Hills rise above Moonbrook in southern Westfall, where Defias outlaws watch the rocky ridges. Stormwind's royal patrols are gone, leaving the dry highland as a natural stronghold for the Defias Brotherhood. Knuckledusters, pathstalkers, and highwaymen hide among the crests and scrub. They ambush travelers and watch the approaches to their strongholds below.

Darkness brings its own danger to the Dagger Hills. Leprithus, a wandering ghoul, has been seen stalking the desolate heights after sunset. Outlaws and lingering undead roam the ridge, while Grimbooze Thunderbrew, a dwarven brewer, sets up his distilling equipment in the rugged wilderness despite the dangers nearby.
